config._chainId_note: ✅ OPERATOR-CONFIRMED mainnet chainId 712217 (2026-08-21) — verified unused on chainid.network, differs from testnet 108369. Register at chainlist to claim. Sets the genesis hash + wallet network.
config._etchash_note: ethash + ecip1099FBlock:0 = Etchash (ECIP-1099 'Thanos') from block 0 — the pinned testnet decision (low-VRAM/laptop-friendly). No RandomX.

hathorFee._comment: Consensus-enforced protocol fee on block issuance (DevCoin model): a share of each block's reward is routed to feeAddress (the HathorFeeTreasury) which splits it per the DAO-governed weights. feeBps in basis points.
hathorFee._feeBps_note: ✅ OPERATOR-CONFIRMED 2026-08-24: DevCoin pool-dev fee = 200 (2.00%) — Hathor's cut from every block, like a pool dev. Chosen over 3%/5% as the competitive pool-fee sweet spot (still real at scale, low enough to draw miners). SEALED at genesis. The HASH:TASK split beyond it is dynamic via HashTaskWeightConfig.
hathorFee._feeAddress_note: MUST be set to the deployed HathorFeeTreasury address at genesis-prep (non-zero) OR use a pre-computed deterministic deploy address. Zero here is a placeholder.

config._ecip1017_note: PRANA 10%/yr emission decay: retuned ECIP-1017 (9/10 per era, base=2 PRANA). Activates blk 10000; era=1yr.
